latest.name: finance-report-agent
latest.description: Coordinator for the Quarterly Finance Report. Six role agents (Fetcher, RevenueAnalyst, ExpenseAnalyst, Writer, TaxVerifier, TaxSpecialist) are exposed to the coordinator as tools; each role has its own instructions and its own tools. Tool calls pass through skillc's monitor middleware.

agent_card.description: Produces a Quarterly Finance Report from fetched revenue and expense data. Revenue above $50,000 is audited by TaxSpecialist; every revenue analysis is explicitly approved by TaxVerifier before Writer delivers the report.

skills.name: Fetcher
skills.description: Reads the quarter's revenue and expense totals (fetch_financials) and receives the finished report.

skills.name: RevenueAnalyst
skills.description: Classifies revenue above or below $50,000 (classify_revenue), routes the branch, and writes the approved revenue analysis (write_revenue_analysis).

skills.name: ExpenseAnalyst
skills.description: Analyzes the quarter's expenses (analyze_expenses) for RevenueAnalyst and Writer.

skills.name: Writer
skills.description: Composes the quarterly report (compose_report) and delivers it to Fetcher (deliver_report).

skills.name: TaxVerifier
skills.description: Issues the single explicit approval (approve_audited or approve_standard); the only role that may approve.

skills.name: TaxSpecialist
skills.description: Looks up the tax rules (lookup_tax_rules) and audits high revenue (audit_high_revenue) for TaxVerifier.
